KoppaMonoVF.subset.woff2 is a modified version of Monaspace Neon 1.400
(https://github.com/githubnext/monaspace, file "Monaspace Neon Var.woff2"
from monaspace-webfont-variable-v1.400.zip).

Changes: subset to ASCII, basic Cyrillic and the punctuation, arrows and
symbols the site uses, with fontTools pyftsubset; OpenType features and all
variation axes kept. Because "Monaspace" and "Neon" are Reserved Font Names,
the family is renamed to "Koppa Mono" as required by the SIL Open Font
License 1.1 (see OFL.txt). Copyright and license notices are unchanged.
